회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
Job Overview and Focus areas
Rocket Growth (RG) is a program that helps sellers leverage Coupang’s best in class rocket delivery and fulfillment network to serve customers and grow their business. With Rocket Growth, sellers are eligible to earn the rocket badge, thereby accelerating their sales, and providing customers with rocket-speed delivery for their items. Rocket Growth customers also get Coupang’s world-class customer service, including free shipping and returns for WoW members.
Rocket Growth is Coupang's fastest-growing team, with an ambitious product and feature roadmap in the works. We are looking for motivated leaders who enjoy working with smart people to innovate and make history by solving complex and exciting problems.
As a
Senior Product Manager
, you will own and drive your product area from start to finish. You will identify opportunities, formulate strategies and the execution plan, align stakeholders, socialize your plan, define success metrics, and finally implement, launch and measure the impact. You will independently define and own the KPIs that drive the OKRs in your area.
You have a strong sense of judgment and a mindset that continuously questions the status quo. You have the swagger to work with various stakeholders to bring them together around common objectives and then lead them to execution. You enjoy working with and analyzing data to develop insights.
Successful applicants will love delving deep into data, have strong analytical skills, outstanding communication tactics, and be comfortable with executive-level evaluations. You will be at ease engaging with technical software development teams and flourish in a collaborative, creative, analytical, and quick-paced atmosphere. You should possess the knowledge and skills necessary to create documents for top executives. This is a high-profile role that will interact with people at all levels of the organization.
Research: Identify areas where the overall experience may be improved and gather product requirements from customers and business stakeholders.
• Strategy and communication: To ensure that projects run well, reach an understanding with stakeholders regarding the specifics and timelines of the strategy.
• Roadmap management: oversee the product roadmap and assign priorities depending on the impact to the business.
• Execute: Manage every step of the product lifecycle, including use case definition, success metrics, solution discovery, strategy development, launch, A/B testing, impact analysis, etc.
• Mentor: Train up-and-coming product managers and assist them in carrying out the crucial tasks assigned as part of the team's overall OKRs.
• Collaborate: Establish strong working relationships with stakeholders from the customer, business, and UX design communities to guarantee planned product features are delivered and OKRs are met.
Basic Qualifications:
• 8+ years in a senior position inside a business or in product management, supply chain management, or strategic consulting.
• Leadership experience with a history of launching and managing products and dealing with ambiguity and complexity.
• Strong verbal and written communication abilities. Ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Expertise presenting insights to leadership and other stakeholders based on deep dive analysis and research.
• Proven track record of leading company and roadmap strategy while managing tradeoffs in multi-sided marketplaces.
• Hands on experience driving product launches from ideation to market maturity.
• Ability to deal with ambiguity in a fast-paced work environment with changing priorities.
• Bachelor's degree.
Preferred Qualifications:
• MBA from Top ranked Business school
• In-depth expertise in fulfillment and warehouse services as well as online retail.
• Strong Bias for action and getting results attitude.
• Bilingual Korean - English

jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Manager, Product & Solutions – Digital Payments & Consumer Products About the Customer Solutions Center The Customer Solutions Center is Mastercard’s local product and solutions function, bringing together Mastercard’s products, services, and expertise to address customer and market needs. The team partners closely with account management, sales, regional product teams, technology, and delivery teams to translate Mastercard’s capabilities into customer-relevant solutions and accelerate their successful deployment in the market. To further accelerate our digital agenda, we are expanding the Customer Solutions Center with a Manager, Product & Solutions – Digital Payments & Consumer Products, based in Amsterdam and responsible for the Netherlands and Iceland. About the Role As Manager, Product & Solutions – Digital Payments & Consumer Products, you will be a go-to product expert for financial institutions in the Netherlands and Iceland, with a particular focus on accelerating the adoption and deployment of Mastercard’s digital payment solutions. A key focus of the role will be helping issuing institutions design and implement the next generation of digital payment experiences, including Click to Pay, tokenization, authentication, payment passkeys, digital wallets, and related digital capabilities. Alongside Digital Payments, you will support Mastercard’s broader Consumer Products portfolio, helping customers develop compelling consumer payment propositions and ensuring that Mastercard’s digital capabilities are embedded into the overall customer experience. You will work closely with sales, account management, product, and delivery teams to move opportunities from customer discovery and solution design through implementation and market deployment. A strong focus on digital payments, consumer experience, product enablement, and execution will be central to the role. Role and Responsibilities As the customer-facing product and solutions expert for Digital Payments and Consumer Products in the Netherlands and Iceland, you will: Drive digital payment adoption. Accelerate the deployment and adoption of Mastercard digital solutions, including Click to Pay, tokenization, digital wallets, agentic commerce and related capabilities. Lead customer solution discovery. Work with financial institutions to understand their business objectives, consumer needs, technology environment, and digital payment strategy. Shape digital payment solutions. Help customers define their approach, customer journeys, requirements, and implementation plans for Mastercard digital solutions. Support Click to Pay enablement. Help issuers assess their Click to Pay strategy, consumer journeys, dependencies, and implementation readiness. Accelerate tokenization and authentication. Support customers in understanding and deploying Mastercard’s tokenization and authentication capabilities as foundational components of secure and seamless digital payments. Support emerging digital payment capabilities. Build expertise in new Mastercard digital technologies and help customers understand how these capabilities can improve security, convenience, and the overall payment experience. Support Consumer Products. Work with customers and Mastercard product teams to develop relevant consumer payment propositions, ensuring that digital capabilities and consumer product strategies are brought together into a coherent customer experience. Bridge business and technology. Communicate effectively with business leaders, product managers, technology teams, operations teams, and customer-experience specialists, translating complex product and technology topics into clear business and customer implications. Provide pre- and post-sale expertise. Support account managers and sales teams in customer meetings, solution presentations, strategic opportunities, and requests for proposal, and continue to provide product expertise through implementation. Coordinate implementation. Partner with delivery, product, technology, and customer teams to define milestones, identify dependencies, manage risks, and maintain momentum from solution design through deployment. Resolve enablement barriers. Identify recurring product, technology, operational, or customer-experience challenges and coordinate with the appropriate Mastercard teams to support their resolution. Connect local customers with European product teams. Maintain close relationships with Digital Payments, Consumer Products, Product Enablement, and technology teams across Europe to remain current on product capabilities, roadmaps, implementation requirements, and best practices. Support commercialization and adoption. Translate Mastercard capabilities into clear customer value propositions and help develop the enablement approach required to move solutions from opportunity to implementation and adoption. Build internal capability. Share product knowledge, implementation experience, customer insights, and best practices with account teams and the broader Customer Solutions Center. All About You 5+ years of relevant professional experience in product enablement, solution architecture, product management, technical consulting, product commercialization, or a comparable customer-facing role. Strong experience working directly with customers to understand requirements, facilitate workshops, design solutions, and support implementation. Good understanding of the payments ecosystem and the role of issuers, processors, payment networks, digital wallets, merchants, payment service providers, and technology partners. Experience with digital payments, tokenization, digital wallets, e-commerce payments, or related technologies. Ability to translate business and consumer needs into practical product, technology, and customer-experience requirements. Strong understanding of digital customer journeys and user experience, particularly within banking, payments, or commerce. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex product and technology topics clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences. Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives involving sales, account management, product, technology, delivery, and customer teams. Strong planning and organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and dependencies. A proactive, collaborative, and solution-oriented working style with the ability to operate effectively in an international and matrixed organization. Fluency in written and spoken English and Dutch. Willingness to travel to support customers and internal collaboration, particularly within the Netherlands, Iceland, and Europe. Desirable Experience Experience working within a bank, issuer, processor, payment network, fintech, digital wallet, or payment-technology provider. Knowledge of digital payment capabilities such as Click to Pay, network tokenization, digital wallets, EMV 3-D Secure, authentication, or payment passkeys. Experience developing or enabling consumer debit, credit, or premium payment propositions. Familiarity with the regulatory, privacy, security, and operational considerations associated with deploying digital payment solutions. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Our comprehensive benefits program is designed to meet you where you are — through all of life’s stages. We’ve got you and your family covered with benefits that support your health, finances, and overall wellness. 분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요.

Eats Business Management팀은 Eats 조직원을 관리하는 팀으로 채용, 교육, 평가, 보상, 인사관리, 조직문화, 총무 업무 등을 기획하고 진행합니다. 전반적인 HR과 GA 업무를 담당하면서 조직원들이 업무를 최대한 효율적으로 진행할 수 있도록 기여합니다.

Eats Business Management 팀에서 빠르게 성장하고 도전적인 환경에서 조직원들이 보다 효율적으로 일할 수 있도록 도움 주실 HRM 담당자를 찾고 있습니다. 정해진 프로세스를 단순히 수행하는 것에 그치지 않고, 다양한 구성원 및 유관부서와 협업하며 HR운영의 완성도를 높이고 구성원에게 더 나은 Employee Experience를 만들어갈 분을 찾고 있습니다.

They have strong technical, analytical, and communication skills to liaise effectively with engineering and executive teams. Key job responsibilities Define the strategy for the evolution of Prime Video’s response to video on demand impacting incidents. Establish the operating model for how the new, dedicated function will operate within Prime Video. As a technical lead, leverage your domain expertise to, develop the vision for the incident response tooling and capabilities needed to minimise the duration of customer impacting incidents. Increase the scope of team-maintained dashboards. Influence the roadmaps of the engineering teams developing incident management, observability and triage tooling. Lead the Incident Response function. Ensure the globally distributed team is ready to respond 24x7. Actively mentor and develop the junior Incident Managers. Own operational metrics. Set clear, measurable, goals for the quality of incident response and establish mechanisms to drive continual improvement. Foster a culture of continuous improvement through mentoring, feedback and metrics Lead incident response for high severity incidents. Decompose complex incidents into work streams that can be managed by multiple incident responders in parallel. Manage communications and be the single point of contact for executive leaders Drive critical, complex customer escalations in situations that are sometimes technically challenging in collaboration with Engineering Teams Build relationships with the other Incident Response teams across Amazon to share best practice and enable effective collaboration during cross organizational outages/incidents Educate leaders and engineers across Prime Video on advances in incident response capabilities, the role they play in enabling improved incident response and how they can leverage READI tooling to reduce time to mitigate lower severity incidents. Communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences. Scopely is looking for an
Lead 2D Artist
to join our MONOPOLY GO! Game team in Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis (3X week in office).
At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.
What You Will Do
Establish and uphold the 2D vision for each season, in close partnership with Content Leadership, Principal Artist and the Art Director.
Set the bar for quality, technical craft, and AI-assisted workflows, and hold both internal and outsourced artists to it.
Identifying where Ai assisted workflows create meaningful production value, establishing standards for quality and consistency, and turning successful experimentation into repeatable practices the wider team can adopt.
Own and continuously improve 2D's art standards and guideline documentation, partnering with Integration and Technical Art on implementation.
Manage and mentor the discipline, owning performance reviews, goal-setting, and team health.
Take part in hiring to make sure new hires are the right fit, and champion the team's culture.
Be the primary point of contact and voice for 2D, coordinating the discipline's work with the rest of production, from planning through delivery.
What We’re Looking For
8+ years experience as a 2D/concept artist working in games, including 3+ years leading, mentoring, and setting the artistic bar for a team.
Demonstrated experience developing, scaling, and driving adoption of AI-assisted creative workflows, with the judgment to evaluate their impact on quality, consistency, efficiency, and downstream production.
Track record shipping multiple mobile titles in casual/whimsical art styles, partnering across Design, Engineering, and outsourcing to deliver high-quality content.
Expert-level 2D illustration and concept skills, including composition, form, and color, backed by mastery of Photoshop and a strong ability to research and reference material that supports idea generation.
Positive attitude and the ability to give and receive objective feedback.
Bonus Points
Experience navigating the brand guidelines and approval pipeline of at least one externally-licensed IP.
Experience managing or supporting multiple outsourcing partners while holding their output to a consistent quality standard.
Strong 3D modeling proficiency in Maya, Blender, or equivalent, enabling AI-assisted concept-to-3D-asset workflows.
A passion for playing and making games.
